$description: Spacing, sizes, corners and edges. Everything on a 4px grid.

4.$description: A label and its control; keys in a row

8.$description: Between rows and cards; icon to text in a key

12.$description: Inside a group box or row; between sections of a window

16.$description: A window's or screen's content to its edge

title-bar.$description: Window title bars; 52px on the phone (size.header-touch)

group-header.$description: The dithered strip on top of a group box

led.$description: The light in a title bar

dither.$description: Tile of the dither texture (a 1px checkerboard)

key-depth.$description: A key's bottom edge; 3px on the phone's main key

legacy.$description: Plasma's current glass look, still read by the Plasma style builds. Removed with the Plasma reskin
